source.name: chicagofirefc.com – 'Chicago Fire FC Kicks Off Multi-Year Partnership with Carvana as Official Online Auto Retailer and Front of Kit Sponsor'
source.quote: Carvana will become the Club’s Front of Kit Partner with its logo appearing across the front of Chicago Fire First Team

note: Multi-year agreement announced 2023-12-12, with the Carvana logo first on the jerseys for the 2024 season; renewed for 2026, when Carvana also became the first founding partner of the club's new stadium (chicagofirefc.com, 2026-02-10). No reported deal value.
